findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Hand sink in the salad prep area and near the dish machine are observed to have started detaching from the wall which has caused a gap to form where the caulking is present. These sinks need to be securely reattached to the wall and resealed with fresh caulking to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Concentration of bleach solution in kitchen sani-bucket was at 100ppm. Product label directions show a required concentration of 150-200ppm. Solution was recently prepared, so additional bleach was added to provide proper concentration.   
A chlorine solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration of solutions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The wood around a screen under the kitchen 2 pan sink is raw wood.  Sand and paint the wood frame.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The chest freezer has a build-up of frost in it.  Defrost the freezer.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
(A) The faucets on the sinks in the women's restroom do not stay on for a minimum of 15 seconds.   Repair them so they stay on at least 15 seconds.
(B)The left sink faucet in the women's restroom leaks around the base when turned on.  Repair or replace the faucet.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A) The ceiling tiles in both restrooms are acoustic tiles.  On or before the next remodel of the facilities, replace the tiles with ones that are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.
(B)The urinals in the men's restroom have gaps between the urinals and wall.  Seal the gaps.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
A light bulb in the vent hood over the convection oven is burnt out.  Replace the bulb.

750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
A Styrofoam cup was being used as a scoop in the bulk sugar.
750-160 Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact.
The cup was removed to CORRECT the violation.  Replace the cup with a scoop that has a handle and store the scoop on a clean, dry surface or in the sugar with the handle up out of the sugar.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
There is a wood shelf under the service counter that is raw wood.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Paint the shelf.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The legs on the convection oven are dusty.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Clean the legs.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Eating utensils in a drawer under the service counter are stored with the eating ends and handles intermixed.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.
Store the utensils so the handles are all in one direction.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A) There are gaps forming in the caulk joints between the (1) kitchen handsink and wall, and (2) between the 3-pan sink and wall.
(B) The restroom ceiling tiles are acoustic tiles.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents. 
Remove the old caulk from the sink-to-wall joints and re-caulk the gaps.  On or before the next remodel, replace the bathroom ceiling tiles with ones that are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Old mouse droppings/debris were observed on the air exchange pipe of the furnace in the dry storage room. Clean the air exchange pipe and all general surfaces in the dry storage room.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Loose coving was observed by the door frame inside the dry storage room. Small gap was observed where coving meets at the corner (corner immediately inside the room/furthest from the door frame). Properly seal all loose coving and make necessary repairs to areas with gaps.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Old mouse droppings/debris were observed on the air exchange pipe of the furnace in the dry storage room. Clean the air exchange pipe and all general surfaces in the dry storage room.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Loose coving was observed by the door frame inside the dry storage room. Small gaps were observed in the corners (closest to the door) and under a section of coving by the metal cabinet in the dry storage room. Properly seal all loose coving and make necessary repairs to areas with gaps. B) Old mouse droppings were observed on the floor to the left of the metal cabinet in the dry storage room. Debris (possibly old nesting material) was observed on floor by the air exchange pipe to the furnace (past the green slatted shelves). Clean the floors throughout the dry storage room. (see general comments)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - Inside microwaves in cafeteria were soiled with old food debris/splash. Wash and sanitize inside the microwaves daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of food debris/splash.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750.1320b - Bleach water in a spray bottle tested at over 200ppm chlorine-test strip turned black when solution was checked. Poisonous or toxic materials shall not be used in any way that contaminates food, equipment/utensils, and not in any way that constitutes a hazard to employees or other persons, or in a way other than in full compliance with the manufacturer's labeling. Solution was remade at proper concentration of 100ppm chlorine. (see general comments)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - Door sweep of walkin cooler was in disrepair (gap at lower left corner). Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Replace the door sweep on the walkin cooler. (see general comments)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) fan covers in walkin cooler (dust buildup); B) inside cabinets below 3 part sink; C) side of cabinets next to stove top/oven (food splash); D) side of stove top/oven (food splash); & E) bottom inside sliding door cooler on service line. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Coving along the wall in dry storage behind the ice machine was loose. Junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch. Re-attach or replace the loose coving. B) Floors were observed to be slightly soiled in the following areas - under cooler next to handsink, under milk cooler, & under chest freezer. Clean the floors in the above mentioned areas and throughout as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. **Clean up glue traps as they begin to accumulate spiders, insects, and general debris.**

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Ceiling of walkin freezer on both sides of the fan had heavy frost buildup. Ceilings and walls shall be maintained to facilitate easy cleaning. Remove frost buildup from the ceiling.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - A) Microwave in the kitchen had sticky food splash on the top inside. B) Drip guard of ice machine was observed to have some mold accumulation on it. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to eliminate buildup of food splash, mold, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed a build-up of soil on the outside of the microwave in the kitchen and the outsides of the cabinets including the handles.  Clean the microwave and cabinets and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed peeling tile by the grease trap.  Provide a smooth, durable, easily cleanable floor.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
